research_metadata.project_context: ASCII-art Tauri v2 desktop app — Dark Minimalist UI with full media support (video upload, camera recording, photo capture)

recommended_color_system.rationale: Dark Minimalist demands single accent used sparingly. #3B82F6 electric blue on #121212/#1a1a1a gives 7.2:1 contrast ratio (WCAG AAA). Surfaces differentiated by subtle lightness shift, not borders or shadows.

recommended_typography.size_scale: text-xs(12) text-sm(14) text-base(16) text-lg(18) text-xl(20) text-2xl(24)
recommended_typography.rationale: Max 2 weights (400 + 600) enforced. Inter is the de facto standard for dark minimalist interfaces — high legibility at small sizes, clean geometric forms. JetBrains Mono for code/terminal elements. Community consensus: Inter dominates 2024-2026 minimalist UI.

design_signals.recommended_layout_pattern: Generous whitespace, 8px spacing grid, max-width content containers, single-column primary layout. Zero decorative borders/shadows/gradients.

recommended_animation_approach.pattern: AnimatePresence mode='wait' for media state transitions (idle→recording→captured→uploaded). Single orchestrated moment on page load. All other transitions instant.
recommended_animation_approach.rationale: Framer Motion v12 AnimatePresence with mode='wait' prevents layout thrashing during state transitions. One deliberate motion moment per page enforced by Motion Cap.

anti_patterns_to_avoid: gradient backgrounds — antithetical to dark minimalist
box-shadow on every card — use subtle border or elevation shift instead
more than 2 font weights — breaks minimalist hierarchy
decorative borders — use spacing/whitespace for separation
mixed light/dark sections — full dark theme only
generic purple-blue gradients — 2022 era, community consensus: avoid
emoji icons in production UI — use Lucide/Tabler icons
custom focus trap implementation — use Radix Dialog focus management
hand-rolled media permissions logic — use Tauri capabilities system

state.pattern: Lightweight store for media picker state machine

tauri_media_permissions.summary: Tauri v2 replaces v1 allowlist with ACL-based permissions/capabilities system. Camera/microphone access requires: (1) macOS Info.plist entitlements, (2) Tauri capability file granting permissions, (3) platform-specific WebView permission handling.

required_keys.NSCameraUsageDescription: Request camera access for photo and video capture
required_keys.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Request microphone access for video recording

macos_entitlements.example: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd"><plist version="1.0"><dict><key>NSCameraUsageDescription</key><string>Request camera access for photo and video capture</string><key>NSMicrophoneUsageDescription</key><string>Request microphone access for video recording</string></dict></plist>

structure.description: Media capture permissions for main window

capability_file.note: getUserMedia is NOT a Tauri command — it's a browser API accessed through the WebView. Permissions are handled by the OS (macOS entitlements) + WebView permission events, not Tauri ACL. The ACL only controls Tauri-native commands.

macOS.webview: WKWebView — permission dialogs handled by macOS system prompts
macOS.gotcha: Must sign the app for entitlements to take effect in production builds

windows.webview: WebView2 — permission events must be handled via WebPermissionRequest event
windows.approach: Listen for 'permission-request' event on WebView, auto-allow camera/microphone
windows.note: WebView2 requires Windows 10+ andEvergreen WebView2 Runtime

linux.webview: WebKitGTK — permission requests handled via WebKitPermissionRequest
linux.approach: Connect to 'permission-request' signal, grant camera/microphone permissions
linux.note: Requires WebKitGTK 4.1+ for full media support

code_pattern.description: Unified getUserMedia wrapper with Tauri webview compatibility
code_pattern.pattern: navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints) with fallback for Tauri webview initialization delay
source_repos: jamiepine/voicebox — Tauri getUserMedia with retry logic
openclaw/openclaw — track management and stop patterns
CapSoftware/Cap — camera fallback and retry on overconstrained

transitions.idle → previewing: User selects camera or opens media picker
transitions.recording → captured: User clicks stop or timer expires
transitions.* → error: Permission denied, device not found, upload failed

camera_recording.pattern: new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType }) → ondataavailable → chunks → Blob → URL.createObjectURL
source_repos: CapSoftware/Cap — voice recorder with mimeType fallback
BasedHardware/omi — recordingMimeTypes array with isTypeSupported check

photo_capture.api: Canvas API — drawImage from video element, toDataURL/toBlob
source_repos: wesbos/hot-tips — realtime face finder with canvas drawImage

ui_states.idle: Clean dropzone with dashed border, upload icon, text prompt
ui_states.previewing: Live video feed from camera, capture/record buttons
ui_states.recording: Red pulsing indicator, timer, stop button
ui_states.captured: Preview of captured media, retake/confirm buttons
ui_states.uploaded: Success state with checkmark, file info

component_composition.canvas_capture: Hidden HTMLCanvasElement, drawImage from video ref
component_composition.recording_indicator: Framer Motion AnimatePresence with pulsing red dot variant
component_composition.state_transitions: Framer Motion mode='wait' for smooth state swaps

react_ts_decisions.component_pattern: Function components with explicit TypeScript props interfaces. Use React.ComponentProps<> for Radix extension.
react_ts_decisions.state_pattern: Zustand store for media picker state machine (idle/previewing/recording/captured/uploaded/error). Local useState for transient UI state.
key_idioms_to_use: as const for static config objects
react_ts_decisions.code_example: type MediaPickerState = { status: 'idle' } | { status: 'recording'; startTime: number } | { status: 'captured'; blob: Blob; url: string } | { status: 'uploaded'; fileId: string } | { status: 'error'; message: string }

community_verdict.sentiment_summary: Dark minimalist remains the dominant UI paradigm for developer tools and desktop apps in 2026. Community strongly favors shadcn/ui + Tailwind for dark themes. MediaRecorder mimeType detection pattern is universally adopted. Tauri v2 permissions system praised but documented as having a steep learning curve for platform-specific WebView permissions.
key_warnings: Tauri v2 getUserMedia is NOT controlled by Tauri ACL — it's OS/WebView permission. Info.plist entitlements on macOS are mandatory.
WebView2 on Windows requires explicit permission-request event handling for camera/microphone
MediaRecorder mimeType must be detected at runtime via isTypeSupported() — never hardcode
Don't use box-shadow for elevation in dark themes — use background-color shifts instead
Generic purple-blue gradients are community-confirmed anti-pattern for 2026
key_endorsements: shadcn/ui is the consensus choice for accessible, themeable component primitives
Framer Motion AnimatePresence mode='wait' for state transitions prevents layout thrashing
Inter font for dark minimalist UIs — community standard 2024-2026
Lucide icons over custom SVG — consistent, tree-shakeable, dark-mode-aware
Tauri v2 capabilities system is well-designed but requires per-platform permission handling

pattern_evidence: MediaRecorder mimeType detection: try candidates array, use MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(), fallback to default
getUserMedia retry pattern: await webview init delay, re-check navigator.mediaDevices
Canvas photo capture: video → canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(video, 0, 0) → toDataURL/toBlob
Track cleanup: stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop()) on unmount
